name: primary-origin-healthz
_note: Canonical health path. /healthz is unauthenticated, returns 200 with body 'ok'. consecutive_fails=1 + retries=2 means: a single full failure with both retries failed marks the origin unhealthy.

name: primary-origin-api-health
_note: Application-tier check. Hits the API stack so it catches DB / cache / queue connectivity issues that /healthz might not.

name: primary-origin-deep-health
_note: Deep health: heavier check that exercises DB read + cache + downstream APIs. consecutive_fails=2 prevents flap. Body match 'ok' guards against captive-portal / proxy intermediaries returning 200 with HTML.
